delivery_target: valid_vspace_obj_detype or any caller that can supply a vs_lookup witness but not a concrete ko_at for the page-structure object
new_lemma:
lemma valid_vspace_obj':
  "\<And>ao p. \<lbrakk> valid_vspace_obj ao s; (\<exists>\<rhd>p) s \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
       valid_vspace_obj ao (detype (untyped_range cap) s)"
  apply (case_tac ao; simp; erule allEI ballEI; clarsimp simp: ran_def;
         drule vs_lookup_pages_vs_lookupI)
  subgoal for p t r ref i by (crush i)
  subgoal for p t i ref by (cases "t i"; crush i)
  subgoal for p t i ref by (cases "t i"; crush i)
  done
rationale: The scanner reports ko_at never appears in the proof body. The proof drives entirely through vs_lookup_pages_preserved via the crush private method, which consumes the `(\<exists>\<rhd>p) s` witness; ko_at is not passed to any rule in the tactic chain. The new lemma is placed inside the same `context begin` block (L285–312) so the private `crush` method is still in scope.
strengthening_claim: (valid_vspace_obj ao s \<and> (\<exists>\<rhd>p) s) ==> (valid_vspace_obj ao s \<and> ko_at (ArchObj ao) p s \<and> (\<exists>\<rhd>p) s)
